title.en: Strengthen real-user Listening and Writing QA
title.zh: 强化真实用户听力与写作组句验收

purpose.en: Make the 03:00 Pacific real-user task verify the complete sentence-builder interaction instead of treating a tab visit or audio click as learning evidence.
purpose.zh: 让太平洋时间凌晨 3 点的真实用户任务验证完整组句交互，不再把打开标签或播放音频当作学习证据。

en: Require a prerequisite check of all 36 official course banks at exactly 120 prebuilt sentences per course.
Require Listening to play a hidden target-language prompt, arrange target-language word tiles, check the answer, show feedback, and advance progress.
Require Writing to show a learner-language prompt, arrange target-language word tiles to match its meaning, check the answer, show feedback, and advance progress.
Keep the installed local real-user LaunchAgent at 03:00 Pacific and correct the automation documentation to match it.
zh: 真实测试开始前确认 36 门正式课程每门恰有 120 句预置题库。
听力必须播放不直接显示的目标语言句子、点选目标语言词块组句、检查答案、显示反馈并推进进度。
写作必须显示学生语言提示、点选目标语言词块完成同义句、检查答案、显示反馈并推进进度。
保留已安装的凌晨 3 点真实用户 LaunchAgent，并修正文档中的时间说明。
凌晨 3 点真实用户测试说明

en: Define visible pass criteria for prompt direction, tile language, feedback state, and question-counter transition in both modes.
Explicitly reject opening the tab, playing audio alone, or clicking unordered tiles as a pass.
Preserve the existing four-language, five-skill, Play, Everyday Speaking, active-minute, legitimate-score, and browser-cleanup requirements.
zh: 为两种模式明确提示方向、词块语言、反馈状态与题号变化等可见通过标准。
明确规定仅打开标签、仅播放音频或乱序点词均不能算通过。
保留四种语言、五项技能、边玩边学、生活口语、有效学习时长、真实评分及浏览器清理要求。

en: Shared policy, architecture, base-feature consistency, and SmartLingo shared-contract gates pass.
The sentence exercise and QA contracts pass and confirm 36 banks, 120 sentences per bank, and ten distinct daily items per skill.
The production route preflight passes all 16 Course, Trial, Play, and Everyday Speaking checks for English, Japanese, Spanish, and Italian.
zh: 共享规则、架构、基础功能一致性及 SmartLingo 共享合约门禁通过。
句子题库与测试合约通过，确认 36 个题库、每库 120 句，以及每项技能每日 10 道不同题。
英语、日语、西班牙语和意大利语的课程、试学、边玩边学及生活口语共 16 项生产路由预检全部通过。

en: The real signed-in Chrome learning round runs as the local 03:00 task and reports any external Gmail, Clerk, microphone, or browser blocker without fabricating a pass.
zh: 真实登录 Chrome 学习轮次由本机凌晨 3 点任务执行；若 Gmail、Clerk、麦克风或浏览器受阻，会如实报告而不会伪造通过。

en: This release tightens SmartLingo QA evidence only and changes no learner data, scoring logic, course content, identity, commerce, or classroom boundary.
zh: 本次只收紧 SmartLingo 测试证据，不改变学习数据、评分逻辑、课程内容、身份、商业或课程教室边界。
